name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 6: Karlsaflogarna - Blackered

distanceKm.displayRecommendation: Use 20 km as the official planning distance. Keep Naturkartan GPX/API/KML as the primary corridor evidence, but do not import the raw multi-segment line without normalizing the Rölle duplicate/spur artifacts.

difficulty.description: Official sources describe a medium-difficulty stage through forest and agricultural landscape. The Borås-side part is mostly gravel road with only short sections where boots may be needed in normal conditions. Near the Ulricehamn side the route includes tractor road/path, wet or muddy sections where boots or wellies may be needed, and a short pasture segment before the municipal boundary.

officialSources.evidence: Lists Etapp 6 as Karlsaflogarna to Blackered, 20 km, about 5.5 hours, medium difficulty, 103 m height difference, mostly gravel road on the Borås side, road and trail access notes, endpoint coordinates, and PDF map link.

officialSources.title: Naturkartan GPX: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 6

officialSources.title: Västsverige/Ulricehamn: Sjuhäradsleden etapp 3-7

camping.generalRule: General allemansrätt permits a tent for one or two nights if it does not damage land or disturb landowners/others; larger groups need landowner permission. Do not camp on public places or protected/recreation areas where local rules prohibit it.

fire.currentStatusOnAccessDate: On 2026-04-29 SÄRF showed outdoor fires allowed under personal responsibility, with grass-fire risk warning.
fire.ruleSummary: Fires must be safe, never on rock, and always subject to municipal/county fire bans. During bans, even designated fireplaces/grill sites may be prohibited.
fire.confidence: high for authority/status at access time; dynamic before import

protectedAreas.notes: No official Länsstyrelsen nature-reserve page was found for Etapp 6 itself. Rölle naturreservat appears near but not on the route in facility screening, and was about 194 m from the route/protected-area boundary; do not import reserve-specific restrictions without GIS confirmation.

waterProtection.notes: Borås has water-protection areas/föreskrifter for municipal water sources including Dalsjöfors context. The rules mainly concern chemicals, excavation, agriculture/forestry and similar activities, not ordinary hiking. Do not tag as a recreational protected area unless a GIS overlay confirms route intersection.

dogsLivestockPrivateLand.notes: Dogs must be kept under strict control, and from March 1 to August 20 must not run loose in nature. Etapp 6 includes a short pasture segment; close gates, keep dogs leashed/under strict control, and avoid entering with dog if livestock with young are present.

roadAndSurfaceHazards.notes: Official sources describe gravel roads, tractor roads/paths, wet sections where boots/wellies can be needed, roads without shoulders and a short pasture segment. Add road-walking caution and wet-surface/muddy-section advisory.

hunting.notes: No hunting closure was found. Add seasonal autumn/winter hunting advisory: wear visible colors, respect temporary 'Jakt pågår'/'Jakt med hund' signs and do not disturb hunting. The 2025/26 elk season in most registered areas was over by the 2026-04-29 access date.

forestry.notes: Forest/agricultural landscape and road/track surfaces make active forestry, timber stacks, blocked tracks, machinery and windthrow plausible operational hazards. No current forestry closure was found.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No official Etapp 6 closure or reroute was found on Borås, Naturkartan, Västsverige, SÄRF or Länsstyrelsen pages checked on 2026-04-29. Keep the trail-wide Naturkartan/STF quality-assurance warning visible despite Västsverige's quality-assured messaging for stages 3-7.

emergency.notes: Södra Älvsborgs Räddningstjänstförbund covers Borås and Ulricehamn. For fire/emergency calls, provide exact position and nearest road; meet rescue services at a road if safe.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official label Karlsaflogarna - Blackered, 20-20.1 km, about 5.5 hours, medium difficulty, 103 m height difference, endpoint coordinates, official PDF/map, Raska-Minas official POI and no official Etapp 6 reserve.

Audited Naturkartan GPX/API, Västsverige Google My Maps KML and OSM relation 5607241. Found direction-correct endpoints and distances, but raw Naturkartan/KML have duplicate/spur linework around Rölle; OSM is continuous but reversed with a start offset.

Identified Karlsaflogarna/Blackered access clusters, Toarps shelter/firepit, Toarp picnic table, Magsjön shelter/fireplace, Raska-Minas stuga/shelter/grill and Dalsjöfors service-detour metadata. Kept Raska-Minas spring/toilet/cup-mark stones pending.

Identified start-side Häljaredsvägen, Toarps kyrka and Dalsjöforsmotet access, plus weak Blackered-side Dammen/Hjärtaredsvägen/Bredaslätt access. Flagged Komskälet as stale/unresolved in current Västtrafik stop-area data.
Found recent Raska-Minas condition/facility evidence from Komoot and older blog/forum reports, including a 2018 broader reroute/map-mismatch note but no current Etapp 6 closure.
Confirmed no section-specific reserve closure, dynamic SÄRF fire rules/status, no confirmed potable water, dog/livestock/pasture/hunting/forestry advisories, and no official Etapp 6 closure found.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Section 6 is strong enough for normalization review with caveats. No second agent batch needed; remaining gaps are geometry normalization around Rölle, weak Blackered public transport, Komskälet stop currentness, exact coordinates for Raska-Minas spring/grill/cup-mark stones, and exact access-object placement at endpoints.

importReadiness.summary: Section 6 has enough official source, GPX/API/KML/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field-report and rules/safety evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because the official-linked geometry needs Rölle normalization, Blackered direct transit is weak, Komskälet may be stale, Raska-Minas water/grill/cup-mark coordinates are unresolved, and fire/transit/currentness checks are dynamic.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 6 is a medium-length stage from Karlsaflogarna to Blackered through forest and agricultural landscape between Dalsjöfors/Toarp and the Ulricehamn side. It begins near Karlsaflogarna with limited bus access from Häljaredsvägen or Toarps kyrka, follows a mix of gravel roads, tractor roads and paths, and passes the Raska-Minas historic cottage and shelter cluster before ending at Blackered. Expect wet or muddy stretches, a short pasture segment and weak public-transport access at Blackered. Carry water; no confirmed potable-water point was found.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 6 GPX/API and Västsverige KML as primary official-linked geometry sources, but normalize the multi-segment Rölle duplicate/spur artifacts into one official-direction LineString. Use OSM relation 5607241 as a topology cross-check after reversing member order, not as a direct replacement because of the Karlsaflogarna start offset.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for section continuity with sections 5 and 7. Model Borås endpoint coordinates and parking/information symbols as nearby access clusters unless a trail manager source confirms they should replace the route-line vertices.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Model Karlsaflogarna and Blackered parking/information as endpoint access metadata pending exact object geometry.
Import Toarps shelter/firepit as short-detour facilities if the app supports near-route facilities.
Import Raska-Minas stuga as a day-use historic/rest POI, not lodging.
Import Raska-Minas vindskydd as an overnight shelter with coordinate caveat.
Keep Raska-Minas grill and spring pending until exact coordinates are verified; do not mark the spring potable.
Keep Magsjön shelter/fireplace pending or day-use only until current condition/overnight status is confirmed.
Treat Dalsjöfors businesses as off-route service-detour metadata, not ordinary trail facilities.
majorCaveats: Naturkartan/STF QA and reroute warnings conflict with Västsverige stage 3-7 quality-assured statement.
Raw Naturkartan GPX/API and Västsverige KML contain Rölle duplicate/spur artifacts and are not import-ready as-is.
OSM relation 5607241 is reversed and starts about 160-180 m from the Naturkartan/Borås Karlsaflogarna endpoint.
Blackered public transport is weak; closest current stops found are roughly 4 km away by straight line.
Komskälet bus-stop reference could not be verified in current Västtrafik stop-area data.
No confirmed potable water source found; Raska-Minas spring remains pending/non-potable until verified.
importReadiness.nextSafeStep: Commit this section packet, then proceed to section 7 six-agent batch with special attention to the previously observed >500 m GPX gap, Blackered access continuity, livestock/pasture notes, Brunns kyrkoruin and Prången/Ulricehamn access.
